# Contributing to FasterCurrencyDeposits

First off, thank you for considering contributing to the development of this Elder Scrolls Online Add-On! Your support helps make the game better for everyone.

## Found a Bug?

If you have found a bug we absolutely want to know about it. Here are the steps you can take to notify us of the bug:

* [Create an issue](https://github.com/cdmanning/ESO-Addon-FasterCurrencyDeposits/issues) and apply the `bug` label.
* You can also reach out to [cdmanning](https://github.com/cdmanning) directly if you have specific questions regarding a bug or UI error.

## Got a Suggestion?

Do you have ideas to improve **[FasterCurrencyDeposits](https://github.com/cdmanning/ESO-Addon-FasterCurrencyDeposits)**? Whether it’s a feature request or a performance tweak, we want to hear about it.

* Please [create an issue](https://github.com/cdmanning/ESO-Addon-FasterCurrencyDeposits/issues) with the `enhancement` label to pitch your idea.

## Have a Question?

If you are unsure how something works or need help setting up the addon:

* Feel free to reach out and [create an issue](https://github.com/cdmanning/ESO-Addon-FasterCurrencyDeposits/issues) with the `question` label, and we will respond as soon as possible.

Thanks again for your support!
